name: @futon/xiang-client
description: TypeScript client for the 象 (M-象-2000) turn pipeline: records, marks, acceptance and undo, invoke-stream, Matrix rendering.

scripts.build:widget: esbuild widget/main.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/widget/main.js && cp widget/index.html widget/style.css dist/widget/
scripts.build:chat: esbuild chat/main.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/chat/main.js && cp chat/index.html chat/style.css dist/chat/ && cp -R chat/et-book chat/marks dist/chat/ && mkdir -p dist/chat/katex && cp node_modules/katex/dist/katex.min.css dist/chat/katex/ && cp -R node_modules/katex/dist/fonts dist/chat/katex/
